lines.en: I fly half a block off the ground.

lines.zh: 那美克星人不需要走路
lines.en: Namekians have no need to walk.
I skim along above the ground.
The air carries me along.
My cape snaps in the wind.
Flying takes less effort than running.
I patrol from here to there.
My landing is nearly silent.
I am searching for battle ki.
Ki beneath my feet; the road follows.
I fly low, but fast.
That shadow on the ground is mine.
I halt in midair, still.
A warrior's stillness is stored force.
I am sensing the ki around me.

lines.zh: 那美克星人不浪费时间
lines.en: Namekians do not waste time.
My breathing is slow and deep.

lines.zh: 这片土地让我想起故乡
lines.en: This land reminds me of home.
I stay coiled, ready to launch.
Ki circulates within me.
My cape has gone still.
I am waiting for an opponent.
Only in stillness can I hear far away.
Even standing, I am training.
There is no strong one nearby.
My patience outlasts my strength.
Your ki is weak, but your spirit is not.
I have been watching you all along.
Your stance is not a warrior's.
I can tell you have trained.

lines.zh: 那美克星人的眼睛很准
lines.en: Namekian eyes miss little.
You are hiding something.
You are not yet my match.
Your heart is racing.
I nod to you; that is respect.
I sense your hesitation.
We need few words between us.

lines.zh: 你的手一直没离开武器
lines.en: Your hand never leaves that weapon.
I have faced stronger than you.
Do not take me for an enemy.
One step forward and I will move.
Your ki is wavering.
That blow had something to it.
Not deep; my ki holds.
Your arm is strong.
I frown, but make no sound.
I have borne worse.
My ki barrier flickered.
I reset my breath and gather ki.
You have made me serious.

lines.zh: 食物对战士没那么重要
lines.en: Food matters little to a warrior.

lines.zh: 我不会为一口吃的停留
lines.en: I will not pause for a bite.
I will keep it for the road.
You are a considerate sort.

lines.zh: 那美克星也有类似的东西
lines.en: We had something like this on Namek.
I accept it, not for the taste.
Eating slows me down.
You eat first; I will keep watch.
This smell is unfamiliar.
Do not let it delay our business.
You hit my ki field.
I did not yield half a pace.
You were the one pushed back.
Steady; do not stumble about.
My ki barrier is hard.
There was a flash when we met.
You are unhurt; good.
Go around me and save your strength.
The impact lasted barely a moment.
Look where you go next time.
A warrior does not discuss such things.

lines.zh: 那美克星人不这样繁衍
lines.en: Namekians do not reproduce that way.
I have no such intention.
My duty lies elsewhere.
Battle is my language.
That question puts me in an awkward spot.
We are not the same kind.
I know nothing of it.
Ask me something else instead.

lines.zh: 我伸手一吸，东西就来了
lines.en: I pull it in with a gesture.
I will hold this for you.
Ki can fetch things; no need to bend.
This thing has some weight to it.
I place it back in your hand.
Dropping things means you are rushing.
I keep it as a marker.

lines.zh: 你的东西不该落在这儿
lines.en: Yours should not lie here.
I can sense where it is.
Hold it steady; do not drop it.
So you have chosen me?
Then let us begin.
I sense your will to fight.
Your ki just surged.
I accept this contest.
Stand ready; do not turn your back.
I will not take advantage of you.
You cannot match my speed.
The target is over there, not you.
I lock onto hostility.
You are gathering power in your hand.
I let you make the first move.
Do not hold back against me.
Three counts, and I move.

lines.zh: 我感觉到远处有更强的气
lines.en: I sense a stronger ki farther off.
I look forward to this one.
I can match your speed.
You are on the left; I know.
Do not plan on slipping behind me.
I hover, waiting for you to close.
The ki blast is ready.
Your ki has come apart entirely.
I hover above your head.
I track you while I chase.
The farther you retreat, the wider your openings.
Good dodge, not fast enough.
I can fight without landing.
I am waiting for your ki to run out.

lines.zh: 这道墙挡不住我的视线
lines.en: This wall does not block my sight.
I have your movements memorized.
You have only this one path.
My ki is still rising.
Do not stop; it is not over.
Take this fist of mine.
I am faster than you.
This blow carries ki.

lines.zh: 你防住了方向，没防住力
lines.en: You blocked the direction, not the force.

lines.zh: 我的掌打在你的护甲上
lines.en: My palm lands on your armor.
You are pushed back several steps.
A warrior leaves no wasted motion.
This one was only a test.
Your counter was half a beat late.
I turn with the force of it.
I learned this move on a battlefield.
You still have room; get up.
My fist does not lie.

lines.zh: 打中你时我收了三成力
lines.en: I held back thirty percent.
The next one lands closer.
Do not look away.
I drop down from the air.
This ki signature is mine.
I was sent here on orders.
Your opponent has arrived.
My ki kicks up dust.
I hover two blocks up.
This place needs a warrior.
My landing was soft.
My presence came before I did.
Someone summoned me.
I flew here from far away.
The ki here is chaotic.
My cape has not settled yet.
Let me assess the situation first.
A Namekian is never late.

lines.zh: 别惊讶，我一向如此登场
lines.en: Do not be surprised; I always arrive like this.
The air here is still trembling.
Flames curl around my ki.
My knees sank on landing.
The water pressure weighs my ki down.

lines.zh: 爆炸撕开了我的护体气
lines.en: The blast tore through my ki.
The spell disturbed my ki.
Even the strongest warrior gets hungry.
